text: {"lessons":["My account grew about 20.7% while I made no trades; staying invested can work, but this outcome does not prove that prices will keep rising.","Because past price moves do not predict future moves, I should not chase this run-up or assume recent gains will continue.","I should review my holdings periodically and trade only when a clear change in prospects or my portfolio plan justifies it—not to avoid admitting a mistake or to lock in gains for emotional satisfaction."]}
